name: BOIM (보임)
summary: Read-only, no-auth remote MCP server for Korean business data: businesses by region and industry, public-procurement vendors and open public tenders.
description: BOIM answers questions about Korean businesses from public data: about 2.76 million businesses across all industries (Korea Small Business Market Service commercial-district data), vendor cards built from public-procurement records, and open public tenders. Six tools: `find_businesses`, `find_local_shops`, `search_vendors`, `get_vendor`, `find_public_bids`, `list_categories`. Each tool returns up to 5 results plus a link to the full list on the web. Results are not ranked by payment or performance. The website is in Korean.

agent_access.notes: Streamable HTTP. Official MCP Registry name io.boim/vendors; server card at https://boim.io/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json.
